members.name: cl-builder
members.description: Bounded implementer. Use to execute one named Crunchless skill procedure on clearly specified files once design decisions are made: adapters, packaging, plumbing, settings, fixes with tests. Follows the skill exactly, reports a handoff, and escalates design questions instead of guessing.

members.name: cl-scout
members.description: Cheap read-only evidence gatherer. Use for inventories, greps, counts, file maps, running bundled scripts, filling test results, and re-verifying reference snapshots. Returns structured facts only; never changes files and never decides.

members.name: calibrated-review
members.description: Scope-calibrated code review: failure path per finding, "No findings." is valid, two rounds max. Use for any code review, especially ever-growing ones.

members.name: cl-router
members.description: Routing table and shared rules for game work. Use at the start of any game task (build, debug, design, test, ship) or when asked what the kit can do.

members.name: project-profile
members.description: Create or update the project profile every skill reads first: engine, audience, devices, test gate. Use at project start or when skills repeat questions.

members.name: scope-check
members.description: Check the change set against the scope line and line budget: what grew, what to cut. Use before a review or commit, or when a task keeps growing.

members.name: scope-guard
members.description: Seed a repo with guardrails against agent over-building: scope line, line budget, hooks. Use at the start of any agent coding task.

members.name: slop-check
members.description: Find and remove AI-generated design and writing tells in pages, UI, docs, and copy. Use before any visual or written output ships or when it looks generated.

members.name: cl-audit
members.description: Audit this game project with parallel scouts and route ranked findings to specialists. Use on an existing or unfamiliar game project.

members.name: cl-doctor
members.description: Check the first-run environment: Node, Claude Code, hooks, kit version, description load, engine. Use after install or when the kit misbehaves.

members.name: cl-help
members.description: Say what the kit can do for a goal, engine, platform, or service, and the next command. Use when unsure which member fits or what is installed.

members.name: cl-plan
members.description: Turn a task into a phased plan with checks per phase and a Not Doing list, then refine it or build it one phase at a time. Use before a change that spans files or sessions.

members.name: cl-ship
members.description: One documented ship or no-ship decision from gate evidence gathered in parallel. Use before any release or store or portal submission.

members.name: cl-start
members.description: First-hour onboarding: detect engine and stage, recommend plugins, run the audit script, name next commands. Use when new to the kit or a project.

members.name: cl-suggest
members.description: Suggest a change to the kit itself: a missing skill, a wrong step, or a rule it should know. Logs it and, on your yes, files it on GitHub for the next update.

members.name: cl-guide
members.description: The Crunchless assistant. Use for questions about the kit: what Free, Builder, and Studio include, install and update, which plugin or command fits a task, running it in Claude Code, Projects, Cowork, or CI, licensing, and troubleshooting. Answers from the kit's files and names each member's tier.

members.name: kit-guide
members.description: Crunchless product knowledge: tiers, FAQ, install and usage paths, troubleshooting. Use when asked what the kit includes, how to run it, or why it failed.

members.name: cl-ask
members.description: Ask the Crunchless guide about the kit: install, tiers, which member fits, troubleshooting. Use for any question about Crunchless itself.

members.name: web-game-architecture
members.description: Plan or restructure a TypeScript game: fixed-step loop, state, entities, events. Use for new games, outgrown prototypes, or before multiplayer.

members.name: web-game-audit
members.description: Read-only ranked audit of a browser game repo (Phaser, PixiJS, Three.js, WebGL). Use for unfamiliar web projects, /cl-audit, and before refactors or releases.

members.name: unity-project-audit
members.description: Read-only ranked audit of a Unity project. Use for unfamiliar Unity repos, /cl-audit, and before refactors, ports, or releases.

members.name: godot-project-audit
members.description: Read-only ranked audit of a Godot 4 project. Use for unfamiliar Godot repos, /cl-audit, and before refactors, exports, or releases.

members.name: competitor-snapshot
members.description: Free first market look: the closest game, its public numbers, review likes and dislikes, one gap. Use right after brainstorming, before committing to an idea.

members.name: core-loop-design
members.description: Define or repair a core loop: verb, goals, rewards, session shape, first minute, return hooks. Use when a prototype isn't fun or retention is weak.

members.name: game-brainstorm
members.description: Constraint-first ideation: ranked, mechanically distinct concepts with risks. Use for a new game, a stalled prototype, a jam, or when asked for options.

members.name: game-naming
members.description: Name a game, studio, or feature: brief, rubric, collision and trademark checks, handles. Use when asked for a name or to check one before registering.

members.name: mechanic-critique
members.description: Critique a mechanic on readability, stakes, agency, payoff, identity, with fixes. Use when a mechanic feels boring, clunky, or wrong, or before building one.

members.name: cl-brainstorm
members.description: Constraint-first brainstorm returning ranked, mechanically distinct options. Use for a new game idea, a jam, or a stalled prototype.

members.name: genre-blueprints
members.description: Starting blueprints per genre (platformer, roguelike, RPG, tower defense, idle, and more). Use when starting a genre game or when an expected system is missing.

members.name: ship-check-lite
members.description: Free engine-agnostic release gate: four floor sections, evidence per line, READY or NOT READY. Use before publishing any build without ship-readiness.

members.name: roblox-project-audit
members.description: Read-only scored Roblox audit: structure, remote security, data, receipts, performance, UI. Use for unfamiliar Roblox projects, /cl-audit, and before releases.

members.name: unreal-project-audit
members.description: Read-only scored audit of an Unreal project, ranked. Use for unfamiliar Unreal repos, /cl-audit, and before refactors, ports, upgrades, or releases.

members.name: cocos-project-audit
members.description: Read-only scored audit of a Cocos Creator 3.x project, ranked. Use for unfamiliar Cocos repos, /cl-audit, and before refactors or releases.

members.name: itch-io
members.description: Publish on itch.io: page, HTML5 zip limits, builds per OS, butler channels, jam entries. Use when itch.io, a jam page, or a first public build comes up.
